subject: MSA + Exhibits consolidation and term sequencing for Q4 capacity uplift

Subject: Renewal paperwork + exhibit consolidation for Q4 uplift

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Per our call, HorizonPay is planning the 40% capacity uplift starting Oct 1 and wants to avoid a multi-doc signature path.

Attached is an updated order form (Horizon-HC-OrderForm-v2.pdf) that: 1) consolidates the separate monthly exhibits into a single Exhibit C; 2) pins the uptick pricing for 12 months; and 3) surfaces the transition timeline for Dedicated capacity.

Key asks from our side:
- Can your procurement/legal confirm whether Exhibit C consolidation (single exhibit covering capacity tiers) is acceptable under your internal change controls?
- If so, can you sign the order form and the simple addendum we talked about (one-page term shift) so we can route to DocuSign by next Wednesday (6/30)?

I copied Karthik to align on any raised legal items; he can loop in our legal ops if needed.

Attachments: Horizon-HC-OrderForm-v2.pdf, MAP-uptick-plan.xlsx

Thanks —
Sofia

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@horizonpay.com>

Cc: HorizonPay Legal <legal@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + exhibit consolidation for Q4 uplift

Sofia — thanks for the materials and the clear plan. Our procurement team reviewed the consolidated Exhibit C and while the economics look right, Legal flagged two substantive items:

1) Term sequencing: our legal team needs explicit language that the new Exhibit C supersedes previous capacity exhibits only upon full execution of the addendum; they want to avoid any gap where legacy exhibits could be interpreted as controlling.

2) Data residency note: for the Dedicated pools we need a short clause saying customer data at rest will remain within the us-east-1 region for the agreed capacity footprint; Legal says that must be in the MSA (not just the order form).

I've attached the markups (MSA-exhibit-C-diff.docx). We're happy to move fast but Legal asked that we loop in any redline heatmaps before DocuSign.

Proposed timeline from HorizonPay: they can sign by 7/07 if we close the two items above and provide a final PDF for countersignature.

—Alex
Head of Cloud Partnerships
HorizonPay
Attachment: MSA-exhibit-C-diff.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-23T08:06:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal paperwork + exhibit consolidation for Q4 uplift

Team — looping you both for legal + ops input. Two quick notes after reviewing Horizon's markups:

- Term sequencing: we can add a single sentence to the addendum: "Exhibit C shall supersede any and all prior exhibit(s) related to capacity for the same account as of the Effective Date of this Addendum; provided that such supersession shall occur only upon full execution of this Addendum by both parties." That preserves their ask while keeping the MSA unchanged.

- Data residency: we should avoid putting a hard region in the MSA if the customer later wants region migration. Suggest we add a targeted sentence to Exhibit C and a cross-reference in the order form: "Dedicated capacity for the HorizonPay footprint will be provisioned in us-east-1 unless otherwise agreed in writing." That keeps the MSA general and the operational constraint in the exhibit/order form.

Operational next steps:
1) I will draft the two-line addendum and the Exhibit C update today.
2) Marissa — can you run a quick ops check on whether dedic pool provisioning in us-east-1 at the scale requested has any lead-time constraints we should communicate?

If Horizon is comfortable with the approach, we can route the cleaned PDF to them and ask for countersign by 7/07.

-Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@horizonpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: HorizonPay Legal <legal@horizonpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-25T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + exhibit consolidation for Q4 uplift

Karthik/Sofia — thank you, that proposed split (addendum sentence + exhibit-level residency line) sounds good to our legal team. A few practical items before we sign:

- Please include a short commits table in Exhibit C that maps the tiers to the effective monthly commit quantity and the uplift trigger date. Our procurement needs that to reconcile billing forecasts.
- For the provisioning lead time: can Redwood confirm a 6-week lead for dedicated pool expansion from signed date? That will give our infra team time to schedule migration windows.

If you can send the updated PDF and a DocuSign packet by end of day Tuesday (6/30), we'll try to get countersignature by 7/07 as discussed. Also, please add a single-line reference in the addendum: "This Addendum is governed by the MSA executed between the parties on 2024-10-01 and amends Exhibit C only."

We'll review once you drop the doc. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex
Head of Cloud Partnerships
HorizonPay
